content: modernc.org/sqlite v1.53.0 (published Jun 21 2026). CGO-free pure-Go SQLite transpilation. Supports WAL mode via FileControlPersistWAL. Individual connections are single-goroutine; use sql.DB (database/sql pool) for concurrent access, or SetMaxOpenConns(1) for single-writer pattern. Battle-tested, no C toolchain needed.
